items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: No, I think his name is Simeon or Simeon. ... I believe he was from around here. Yeah, I think he's from around here. But he left from around here before I come here.

ctx.x: I'm trying to think of his name.
I think it's Don L. Howard, but I'm not sure.
No, I think his name is Simeon or Simeon. Simeon?
